t: Sandtex 10Ltr Ultra Smooth Masonry Paint provides a durable, weather-resistant finish for exterior surfaces. This high-quality paint is ideal for refreshing rendered walls, concrete, pebble-dash and stone facades, offering protection against the elements. Its advanced microseal technology creates a breathable, waterproof, and dirt-resistant barrier, maintaining a clean, brilliant white appearance. The water-based formulation allows for easy application by brush, roller or spray, covering 12-16 square metres per litre. Surfaces are touch-dry in 3-4 hours and recoatable within the same timeframe, ensuring efficient project completion for professionals.
b: Suitable for Concrete, Pebble-Dash, Render & Stone
